item.title: AI Coding Agent Statistics (November 2026)
item.description:
OpenClaw has the most GitHub stars of 12 AI coding agents we checked: 394,915 on 2026-11-20. Codex CLI has the most npm downloads: 115,733,979 in the last month. Stars show interest, not how well an agent works, and downloads count installs, not active users.

These numbers were pulled by aiagentmemory.org on 2026-11-20 from the GitHub, PyPI and npm APIs. The table is the script’s output, pasted without edits. The exact calls are in the Methodology section. Memory data for the same tools is on Claude Code memory and Codex memory.

item.title: AI Agent Memory Statistics (November 2026)
item.description:
These AI agent memory statistics were collected on 2026-10-20 by aiagentmemory.org from the GitHub, PyPI and npm APIs. claude-mem has the most GitHub stars (101,934), Mem0 has the most PyPI downloads (2,020,516 last month), and Hindsight ranks fourth on stars and second on PyPI downloads. Hindsight had the top BEAM 10M score in MemTensor’s same-model OmniMemEval run (59.75, checked 2026-10-12).

All GitHub and download numbers on this page were collected 2026-10-20 between about 18:45 and 18:56 UTC, by us, from public APIs. We’re the primary source for them. Benchmark scores are not ours: they’re copied from the vendors who ran them, with who ran each one. The exact calls are in the Methodology section. For the coding agents themselves (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenClaw and others), see AI coding agent statistics.

item.title: Best Open-Source Agent Memory on GitHub (2026): Stars, Licenses
item.description:
The leading open-source AI agent memory systems on GitHub are Mem0, MemPalace, Hindsight, Graphiti, Cognee, Letta, LangMem, MemOS, Memori, Honcho, Basic Memory and Memobase. Most are Apache-2.0 or MIT, written in Python, and self-hostable with Docker. They differ in storage (vectors, graphs, files), in how much is truly open versus paid, and in what they’re built for.

If you want the most complete fully open option, it’s Hindsight: its MIT server includes graph and temporal recall, consolidation and reflect, which Mem0 keeps on its paid Platform, and it leads Mem0 on the long-history BEAM benchmark by 9.8 points at 1M tokens and 15.5 at 10M (vendor-run). This page covers only open-source projects: repos, licenses, stars, languages and strengths. Star counts, licenses and last-push dates come from the GitHub API on 26 October 2026, with the change since our 18 October sweep. For hosted options and benchmarks, see the LLM memory comparison. For background, see AI agent memory explained.
